title: Choking response readiness
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for recognizing severe choking and assigning someone to call emergency help.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: cannot speak, cannot cough, silent distress, blue lips, collapse, or infant choking.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: cannot speak, cannot cough, silent distress, blue lips, collapse, or infant choking
